name: ze_Pt8_FAU
title: Pt8 @ FAU (supercage)
description: Pt8 cluster in the supercage (~11.2 A) of a frozen all-silica faujasite (siliceous Y; NEP89-relaxed rhombohedral primitive cell, 144 framework atoms). Pt clusters in the supercages of Y zeolite are the classic encapsulated noble-metal catalyst (Gallezot et al., J. Catal. 39, 334 (1975)). Caveat: NEP89 is not fitted to metal/zeolite interfaces and the framework is rigid, so cluster-wall binding is qualitative (NEP89 GM: flat Pt8 anchored to the wall by four Pt-O).
